name: All Access
overview: ALL ACCESS, SHOWTIME Sports takes you beyond the boxing ring.

seasons.name: Victor Ortiz
seasons.overview: In anticipation of rising superstar Victor Ortiz's bout against Josesito Lopez, All Access provides viewers with an intimate portrait of Ortiz. Although not limited to the fight game, initial series subjects will take viewers behind the curtain and inside the provocative and often edgy world of boxing and mixed martial arts with virtually unrestricted license as only Showtime can.
